resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Verifier B correct — pricing page (https://newsapi.org/pricing) lists Developer: 100 req/day, development/testing only, 24h article delay, search up to a month old, CORS localhost-only. Original omitted month search window (and CORS detail). Final value includes those official limits. cors: Verifier B correct as "no" — free Developer plan is "CORS enabled for localhost" only; Business/Advanced enable CORS for all origins. Directory cors is binary; free-tier/default is not general browser CORS, so "no" not "unknown". Evidence: https://newsapi.org/pricing.
free_tier_limits: Developer: 100 req/day, development/testing only (not for production); 24h article delay; search up to 1 month old; CORS localhost only
